profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Amazon | Infrastructure Reliability | High-Availability Systems
profile.summary:
I build and operate software systems that are designed to withstand real-world load and failure.

My work has focused on infrastructure reliability, incident response, deployment safety, and operational maturity. I’m particularly interested in how teams transition from “it works” to “it holds under scale.”

I think a lot about:

- Reducing blast radius
- Designing safer rollouts
- Monitoring that actually detects meaningful failure
- Operational philosophy, not just tooling

I occasionally advise software teams on improving reliability practices and operational structure.

If you’re building something ambitious and want your systems to survive growth, I’m open to conversations.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Working on the AWS Amplify team.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · React.js · Amazon ECS · AWS Lambda · Smithy · AWS CloudFormation · AWS Cloud Development Kit

positions.title: Full Stack Software Developer
positions.description:
One skill you need to be successful at Fresh is to be able to Learn Fast. What stands out to me about my work here is the multitude of technologies and customers I worked with. I've heard many times in tech that the largest problems aren't technology but they're people. At Fresh, I refined my communication and team working abilities.

Communication and teamwork are essential skills when you're working across technologies like Web Development and Robotics and people from Software and Hardware teams and customers. I also saw how having a solid foundation in programming skills can transfer across many technologies and allowed me to ramp up and deliver for our customers.

positions.title: Software Engineer with Microsoft IT via InConsulting, Inc
positions.description:
At Microsoft, I worked in the IT Departments Field Mobility and Cloud Services team, to create enterprise apps using Microsoft's cutting edge technology. 

In this role I was working with early versions of Microsoft products including Microsoft Bot Framework and Azure Cognitive Services. I was also at the forefront of implementing Microsoft's new standards for Accessibility.

One of the main missions of the team is called "Microsoft's First & Best Customer." That means we run alpha and beta versions of products and services in production environments to improve product quality and test enterprise scenarios for the product teams.

positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description:
I was a part of a 4 person team to develop a web application to help Judges manage their cases from any device with an Internet connection. 

The goal of the app was to create an intuitive user interface where judges could engage and analyze information for each case.

positions.title: Full Stack Web Developer
positions.description:
HealSwift is a healthtech  startup dedicated to perfectly matching patients with health professionals using a proprietary algorithm. 

HealSwift is where I refined my Web Development skills. I was fortunate to be mentored by two senior developers who taught me why proper organization (clean code) matters if you want to build something that will last. And also why simple code matters, so that other developers will be able to understand easily. I put this into practice when designing the Api, Database and Frontend.

positions.title: Co-Founder / Head of Sales
positions.description: I started Barista Lab when I was in college. I quickly learned what it takes to build a robust e-commerce website, market products in a competitive industry, grow a company to seven figures. This is where I formed my foundational skills in Web Development, Entrepreneurship and Marketing.

positions.title: E-commerce System Designer
positions.description:
Handsome Coffee's first e-commerce website didn't have the features the company needed. They desired a more automated system that integrated the e-commerce website with their manufacturing and accounting systems.

I designed and built the solution and provided staff training on how to use the new technologies to reduce manual data entry.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Our app was called "Ticketmaster Roulette" which we built on site in the Ticketmaster offices in Hollywood, CA. Press the "I'm feeling lucky button" for the app to choose an event for you and your friends to go to and book a ride to the event.

The idea was to solve the pain points of getting a group of friends to agree on what they want to do.

VetsHack.devpost.com
Our team won 3rd place for developing an app to help Veterans transition to civilian life.

projects.title: Handsome Coffee Ecommerce Site
projects.description: Organized the backend functionality to link roasting, accounting and shipping processes to the ecommerce site.
